name: Etapp 20:1: Östa / Ingbo källor to Råsbo

description.long: Official western continuation from the Östa/Ingbo källor area toward Råsbo. The GPX starts at Ingbo källor, about 110 m from the Ingbo parking/service cluster, while Etapp 20 also has separate Östa branches.

utilities: Mapped facilities on this section include parking, toilet, natural water, attraction, rest area, transit.
waterSources: Use listed water rows as planning-grade refill information; seasonal access, non-potable warnings, and local signage override static data.
notes: Official western continuation from the Östa/Ingbo källor area toward Råsbo. The GPX starts at Ingbo källor, about 110 m from the Ingbo parking/service cluster, while Etapp 20 also has separate Östa branches.
